## About Us

Landstar stands for safe, secure and reliable transportation services delivered by a network of
independent freight agents, leased owner-operators and other third-party capacity providers. We
empower these entrepreneurs to offer customized shipping solutions.

Landstar System, Inc. is a technology-enabled, asset-light provider of integrated transportation

# Technology-Driven Supply Chain Solutions Built Around Your Business

Today's supply chains require more than disconnected services. Powered by proprietary digital
platforms, AI-enabled intelligence, automation, and the expertise of our people, Ryder helps you
navigate complexity with greater visibility, control, and confidence. From fleet leasing and
maintenance to dedicated transportation, transportation management, freight brokerage, warehouse
management, contract packaging and manufacturing, e-commerce and omnichannel fulfillment, and
last-mile delivery, we deliver connected port-to-door solutions designed to keep your supply chain
moving and your business ahead.

[ Contact a Ryder Expert ][218] [ Explore Ryder Port2Door™ ][219]

carrier management, financial settlement, and real-time visibility to help you control costs,
improve service, and adapt quickly.

## Managed Transportation You Can Rely On

Our Transportation Management solution combines disciplined carrier qualification, operational
oversight, AI-driven monitoring, and one of the largest transportation networks in North America to
help you move freight with greater confidence, reliability, and control.

Carrier selection matters more than ever. Ryder applies disciplined qualification standards and
ongoing oversight to help you secure reliable capacity from carriers to meet rigorous operational
and safety expectations.

# Technology-Driven Supply Chain Solutions Built Around Your Business

Today's supply chains require more than disconnected services. Powered by proprietary digital
platforms, AI-enabled intelligence, automation, and the expertise of our people, Ryder helps you
navigate complexity with greater visibility, control, and confidence. From fleet leasing and
maintenance to dedicated transportation, transportation management, freight brokerage, warehouse
management, contract packaging and manufacturing, e-commerce and omnichannel fulfillment, and
last-mile delivery, we deliver connected port-to-door solutions designed to keep your supply chain
moving and your business ahead.

# Powering intelligent logistics to drive better outcomes

Navigate disruption with confidence by unifying managed transportation and multi‑modal capacity in a
shared operating model

[Connect with an expert][32]
[See how industry leaders succeed][33]
Semi truck with illuminated headlights driving on dark mountain road at night with snow-capped peaks
in background.

## Tap into one of North America’s largest managed transportation and multimodal capacity networks

We translate network‑level patterns into market insights shippers can trust to plan budgets,
navigate volatility, and unlock structural savings

## $17B+

Freight under management

## 18M

Total shipments annually

## 1.8B

Transactions annually

## $1B

Annual savings for customers

## 1 in 3

Fortune 500 shippers served

## 15,000+

Cities and markets in our global network

View More

## Strategic logistics built for tomorrow’s disruption

Backed by two decades of industry data, leading technology, and hands-on partnership

[Icon of person on black background]

#### Managed services

Run transportation through a single operating layer that aligns procurement decisions, daily
execution, and freight settlement. Financial outcomes, service targets, and carrier accountability
stay coordinated across the shipment lifecycle.

[Drayage icon]

#### Multi-modal solutions

Turn capacity across modes into governed programs tied to your network priorities. Instead of
reacting to coverage gaps with ad-hoc spot moves, your team operates with planned capacity levers
that protect cost and service targets as conditions change.

[Computer icon]

#### TMS and network intelligence

Uber Freight TMS draws on freight activity across thousands of shipper networks, with decades of
accumulated data informing routing and capacity decisions. Predictive signals keep the network
aligned as conditions change, so teams act earlier rather than waiting for issues to surface in the
P&L or at the customer level.

View More
Serving the industries that move North America

### Protect cost and service performance across the automotive supply chain

Uber Freight manages inbound material flow and outbound distribution with the carrier coverage and
network intelligence automotive manufacturers need to protect schedules and avoid costly production
delays.

[Learn More][34]

Customers partner with Uber Freight to improve cost position, service reliability, and network
performance across evolving supply chains. Our average customer tenure is 8.5 years with 98%
customer retention.

[Chemical truck at work site]

#### How a global chemical producer saves millions with Uber Freight’s strategic logistics

filters to narrow down the jobs you want and where you want! From company drivers to teams to reefer

browse? Sign up for instant job alerts that send you a notification when the truck driving jobs you

benefit of only hearing about opportunities with the recruiter or details that you choose. Plus, our
jobs are always current, updated frequently, and ready to be filled immediately! Whether you are
still a student looking for your first trucking career or a seasoned driver, we can place you in the
hottest jobs that cater to your specific qualifications and experience.

alerts all in one place. AllTruckJobs.com provides all the tools you need to make the best choices
in your transportation career. Decide where you want to hear about job listings, whether it is by
email or only from your account on the site.

up to date news in the world of trucking. And don't forget to check out our [AllTruckJobs.com

Antfills is an international logistic service provider that fulfills your ecommerce orders to your
customers. Our goal is to help your brand become more successful by supporting with fastest and most
reliable end-to-end fulfillment and channel distribution solutions as your brand scales.

[Sign Up][22]

# 99.99%

### Inventory Accuracy

Accurate inventory management, minimizing error rate.

# 37%

### Labor Cost Reduction

Intuitive interface allows you to easily manage inventory, logistics, and billing.

# 5min

### Customer Service Response Time

High-level of customer service standard.

# 98%

### Customer Satisfaction

Most customers consider Antfills to be the best partner.

# Integrate Seamlessly

Antfill’s world-class software is ready to connect your ecommerce stores and fulfill your orders
immediately.

# 3PL Evolved, 3PNL.

Antfills is build different. We are consist of a network of 3rd Party Logistic fulfillment
warehouses that is ready to provide the fast and affordable shipping solution that you need to
reduce cost.

# Multi-Channel Distribution – 4PL

Antfills cares about your business. Our goal is help you succeed. Reducing your cost as well as help
you increase your revenue. Our team has solutions to help you further expand your sales channels and
platform.

[[multichannel-4pl]][23]

# The Antfill Advantage

[one-click]

#### Easy and Seamless Integration

Our simplified eCommerce platform integration allows you to manage and synchronize your orders in
real time.

[customer-service]

#### 24/7 Bilingual Customer Service

Our customer support team in China and the U.S. is there to assist on your warehousing and logistics
concerns 24/7.

[efficient]

#### Efficient Data-Driven Platform

Say goodbye to spreadsheets and email and say hello to Antfill’s one-stop solution, including order,
inventory, tracking management, and data analysis.

[allocation]

#### Intelligent Order Allocation

Antfills selects the nearest warehouse to fulfill your orders, based on your shipping destination.

# All-In-One Integration

Antfill integrates with major e-commerce platforms such as Wayfair, Shopify, Walmart, Amazon, and
eBay so that you can fulfill all of your orders in one stop. In addition, reliable and consistent
shipping channels allow us to provide customers with various logistics options and competitive
shipping rates.

[transection]

**Every transaction is instantly recorded and updated.**

[multiple-support]

**Antfill supports multiple online and offline payment options.**

[pricing-structure]

**Simple, affordable and transparent pricing structure with no hidden fee.**

**Antfill’s nationwide**
Antfill’s nationwide warehouse network provides you fulfillment and last-mile delivery solutions.

**Inaccurate inventory information?**
We built an accurate inventory management system that can record every single inventory change. Say
goodbye to confusing inventory records and missing goods.

The intuitive online billing system records and displays each transaction in real time.

**Losing business due to unreliable customer support?**
Our customer service team is professional and energetic, ready to solve your problem 24 hours a day,
seven days a week.

## What is Beginners in AI?

Beginners in AI is a learning library and daily newsletter for non-technical people who want to use
AI well. We are not a research blog. We are not an AI hype account. We explain AI tools, workflows,
and ideas in plain English, with a daily newsletter that hands you one new tool or technique each
morning.

## Who is Beginners in AI for?

People who are curious but not technical. Professionals (teachers, lawyers, doctors, real estate
agents, founders, parents) who want to use AI well in their work without becoming an AI engineer.
Curious learners who heard ChatGPT or Claude was a big deal and want to understand it for
themselves.

## How much does Beginners in AI cost?

The website, the newsletter, the AI glossary, the tool directory, and the Start Here learning path
are free. Special Reports are also free. A small set of products (advanced workshops, [1-on-1

specifically, with practical examples that go beyond surface-level use cases. Third, we are
independent. No corporate sponsor and no AI vendor relationship that shapes coverage. Newsletter
sponsor slots in Beehiiv are paid per click and have no bearing on what we cover or how we cover it.

Every morning, seven days a week. One issue per day, around a 5-minute read. Weekends included so
you never lose the thread.

A short read each morning covering one notable story, one tool worth knowing, and one practical tip.

## What is Beginners in AI?

Beginners in AI is a learning library and daily newsletter for non-technical people who want to use
AI well. We are not a research blog. We are not an AI hype account. We explain AI tools, workflows,
and ideas in plain English, with a daily newsletter that hands you one new tool or technique each
morning.

## Who is Beginners in AI for?

People who are curious but not technical. Professionals (teachers, lawyers, doctors, real estate
agents, founders, parents) who want to use AI well in their work without becoming an AI engineer.
Curious learners who heard ChatGPT or Claude was a big deal and want to understand it for
themselves.

## How much does Beginners in AI cost?

The website, the newsletter, the AI glossary, the tool directory, and the Start Here learning path
are free. Special Reports are also free. A small set of products (advanced workshops, [1-on-1
coaching][84]) are paid and clearly labeled. No paywall on the daily content.

## How is Beginners in AI different from other AI sites?

Three differences. First, every story in the newsletter is human-curated from primary sources
(Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Stanford AI Index, Pew, McKinsey). Most “daily AI” newsletters
now summarize 30 RSS feeds with GPT. We do not. Second, the content library is built for beginners
specifically, with practical examples that go beyond surface-level use cases. Third, we are
independent. No corporate sponsor and no AI vendor relationship that shapes coverage. Newsletter
sponsor slots in Beehiiv are paid per click and have no bearing on what we cover or how we cover it.

## How often does the newsletter ship?

Every morning, seven days a week. One issue per day, around a 5-minute read. Weekends included so
you never lose the thread.

## What do you get with the daily newsletter?

A short read each morning covering one notable story, one tool worth knowing, and one practical tip.
No paywall, no upsells, no AI-generated aggregator content. Just one human-edited briefing to start
the day.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

[1. What freight forwarding services do you provide in Mumbai?][50]

We offer sea freight (FCL/LCL), air freight, rail freight, and multimodal logistics solutions from
Mumbai and JNPT, handling end-to-end shipment management including documentation and customs
clearance.

[2. Who is the best freight forwarder in Mumbai for import export shipments?][51]

Bismarck World provides reliable international freight forwarding in Mumbai with competitive
pricing, real-time tracking, and complete customs compliance support for importers and exporters.

[3. Do you offer customs clearance services at JNPT and Mumbai Port?][52]

Yes, we provide licensed customs clearance services at JNPT (Nhava Sheva) and Mumbai Port, including
Bill of Entry filing, HS code classification, duty calculation, and regulatory approvals.

[4️. How long does customs clearance take at JNPT Mumbai?][53]

Customs clearance timelines at JNPT depend on cargo type and documentation accuracy, but with proper
compliance and expert handling, clearance can be completed quickly to avoid delays and demurrage.

[5. What documents are required for import export clearance in India?][54]

Common documents include Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading/Airway Bill, IEC Code,
Certificate of Origin, and other regulatory permits depending on cargo type.

[6. Do you provide EXIM logistics services in Mumbai?][55]

Yes, we specialize in EXIM transport and logistics services in Mumbai, covering freight forwarding,
customs clearance, warehousing, FTWZ solutions, and inland transport across India.

[7. What are FTWZ services at JNPT and how do they benefit importers?][56]

FTWZ (Free Trade Warehousing Zone) at JNPT allows duty deferment, long-term storage, and efficient
re-export options, helping importers reduce costs and improve supply chain flexibility.

[8. Do you handle air freight forwarding services from Mumbai Airport?][57]

Yes, we provide air freight forwarding services from Mumbai International Airport with fast transit
options for urgent, high-value, and time-sensitive cargo.

[9. What are the freight forwarding charges in Mumbai?][58]

Freight forwarding charges in Mumbai depend on cargo volume, weight, shipping mode (air/sea/rail),
destination, and customs duties. We provide customized quotes based on shipment requirements.

[10. Do you provide rail freight services for inland cargo movement in India?][59]

Yes, we offer rail freight logistics solutions connecting Mumbai and JNPT to major industrial hubs
across India, ensuring cost-effective and timely cargo movement.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

[1. What freight forwarding services do you provide in Mumbai?][50]

We offer sea freight (FCL/LCL), air freight, rail freight, and multimodal logistics solutions from
Mumbai and JNPT, handling end-to-end shipment management including documentation and customs
clearance.

[2. Who is the best freight forwarder in Mumbai for import export shipments?][51]

Bismarck World provides reliable international freight forwarding in Mumbai with competitive
pricing, real-time tracking, and complete customs compliance support for importers and exporters.

[3. Do you offer customs clearance services at JNPT and Mumbai Port?][52]

Yes, we provide licensed customs clearance services at JNPT (Nhava Sheva) and Mumbai Port, including
Bill of Entry filing, HS code classification, duty calculation, and regulatory approvals.

[4️. How long does customs clearance take at JNPT Mumbai?][53]

Customs clearance timelines at JNPT depend on cargo type and documentation accuracy, but with proper
compliance and expert handling, clearance can be completed quickly to avoid delays and demurrage.

[5. What documents are required for import export clearance in India?][54]

Common documents include Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading/Airway Bill, IEC Code,
Certificate of Origin, and other regulatory permits depending on cargo type.

[6. Do you provide EXIM logistics services in Mumbai?][55]

Yes, we specialize in EXIM transport and logistics services in Mumbai, covering freight forwarding,
customs clearance, warehousing, FTWZ solutions, and inland transport across India.

[7. What are FTWZ services at JNPT and how do they benefit importers?][56]

FTWZ (Free Trade Warehousing Zone) at JNPT allows duty deferment, long-term storage, and efficient
re-export options, helping importers reduce costs and improve supply chain flexibility.

[8. Do you handle air freight forwarding services from Mumbai Airport?][57]

Yes, we provide air freight forwarding services from Mumbai International Airport with fast transit
options for urgent, high-value, and time-sensitive cargo.

[9. What are the freight forwarding charges in Mumbai?][58]

Freight forwarding charges in Mumbai depend on cargo volume, weight, shipping mode (air/sea/rail),
destination, and customs duties. We provide customized quotes based on shipment requirements.

[10. Do you provide rail freight services for inland cargo movement in India?][59]

Yes, we offer rail freight logistics solutions connecting Mumbai and JNPT to major industrial hubs
across India, ensuring cost-effective and timely cargo movement.

# Your complete enterprise-ready TMS for trucking

Simplify your trucking operation with the leading cloud-based Transportation Management System (TMS)
software for truckload and LTL carriers and private fleets.

[Book a Demo][11]

## Customized to fit your business needs

Bolt was built with flexibility in mind. We offer a robust turn-key product, while embracing every
opportunity to provide  tailored solutions, workflows, integrations, and reports. Your complexity is
our specialty.

We don’t believe in one-size-fits all.

## Integrate with your existing systems

Bolt connects with systems you already use. We have out-of-the-box integrations with ERPs, ELDs, EDI
VANs, load boards, fuel cards, accounting systems, payroll systems, and much more!

[See more integrations][12]

## Streamline your entire fleet

Bolt was built to cover the full spectrum of order-to-invoice needs for any trucking operation.
Curious if our system can address your unique needs? Email us at [sales@boltsystem.com ][13]or
schedule a demo today.

### Create orders with ease

Whether you need to import orders from your ERP, transact with trading partners via EDI, or build
orders from scratch, we offer numerous tools to streamline this process.

### Dispatch and track loads

Use pre-existing driver and truck assignments or modify loads on the fly with our dispatch
optimization tools. Track load progress with our ELD integrations or our Bolt Driver App.

### On demand customer visibility

Imagine no longer having those customer calls to check on the status of a driver. Our customer
portal allows you to provide easy access to a real-time visual of order status and location,
enhancing your customers’ experience and saving your team time and energy.

### Invoice customers and pay drivers

Aligning with all major accounting and payroll softwares, Bolt eliminates the need for double-entry
and makes it easy to pay and to get paid, increasing your employee retention, your customer
satisfaction, and your cash flow.

### Analyze trip data and allocate expenses

Our system looks at every aspect of your fleet, from maintenance to accessorials, we combine it all
to provide you with the ultimate snapshot to reduce costs and move to the next level.
[See more features][14]

## Bolt TMS scales with our customers

Since our inception in 2003 we have been focused on providing solutions for the problems of private
fleets and for-hire fleets alike. We solve some of the most complex problems for some of the largest
fleets in the country.



#### Private Fleets

Payroll solutions, enterprise integrations with ERPs and accounting systems, and customized
reporting.
* ERP integrations
* Inbound/Outbound Freight Coordination
* Unlimited Distribution Centers
* Multi Segment Loads Relay / Shuttle / Peddle / Last Mile
* Backhauls



#### Dedicated Fleets

EDI integrations, on demand customer visibility and freight tracking, and detailed reporting.
* Custom EDI integrations and on-going support
* Customer portal for real-time order tracking and arrival visibility
* Load templates for simplified order creation
* Quick and efficient invoicing and payroll



#### For-Hire Fleets

Truckload or LTL, complex load structures, fast customer invoicing, ELD integartions, and more!
* Support for complex LTL load structures
* Customer and lane-level reporting
* Dynamic rate types for invoicing and driver and carrier pay
* Many ELD integrations
* Bolt Driver App with workflow
[Bolt Reporting]

Put your data to work

## Reporting to drive actionable insight

Use our powerful business intelligence tools and reporting capabilities to create efficiencies in
your freight operations and automate workflows.

# Based in Nashville,
# built in the cloud

Bolt is a fully cloud-based platform, accessible via web browser on any device with an internet
connection. You’re in the business of managing trucks, not servers, so we’ll handle the work of
keeping your data safe and your system performant.

[Learn more][15]
[Bolt Nashville]


## Dedicated support, at your service

As a Bolt client, you’ll have direct access to our team of fleet experts. They stand ready with
solutions to for-hire, LTL, full truckload, brokerage, backhaul, and private fleet challenges.

Contact us to schedule a demo today.

Bolt connects with systems you already use. We have out-of-the-box integrations with ERPs, ELDs, EDI
VANs, load boards, fuel cards, accounting systems, payroll systems, and much more!

[See more integrations][12]

## Streamline your entire fleet

Bolt was built to cover the full spectrum of order-to-invoice needs for any trucking operation.
Curious if our system can address your unique needs? Email us at [sales@boltsystem.com ][13]or
schedule a demo today.

### Create orders with ease

Whether you need to import orders from your ERP, transact with trading partners via EDI, or build
orders from scratch, we offer numerous tools to streamline this process.

### Dispatch and track loads

Use pre-existing driver and truck assignments or modify loads on the fly with our dispatch
optimization tools. Track load progress with our ELD integrations or our Bolt Driver App.

### On demand customer visibility

Imagine no longer having those customer calls to check on the status of a driver. Our customer
portal allows you to provide easy access to a real-time visual of order status and location,
enhancing your customers’ experience and saving your team time and energy.

### Invoice customers and pay drivers

Aligning with all major accounting and payroll softwares, Bolt eliminates the need for double-entry
and makes it easy to pay and to get paid, increasing your employee retention, your customer
satisfaction, and your cash flow.

### Analyze trip data and allocate expenses

Our system looks at every aspect of your fleet, from maintenance to accessorials, we combine it all
to provide you with the ultimate snapshot to reduce costs and move to the next level.
[See more features][14]

## Bolt TMS scales with our customers

Since our inception in 2003 we have been focused on providing solutions for the problems of private
fleets and for-hire fleets alike. We solve some of the most complex problems for some of the largest
fleets in the country.



#### Private Fleets

Payroll solutions, enterprise integrations with ERPs and accounting systems, and customized
reporting.
* ERP integrations
* Inbound/Outbound Freight Coordination
* Unlimited Distribution Centers
* Multi Segment Loads Relay / Shuttle / Peddle / Last Mile
* Backhauls



#### Dedicated Fleets

EDI integrations, on demand customer visibility and freight tracking, and detailed reporting.
* Custom EDI integrations and on-going support
* Customer portal for real-time order tracking and arrival visibility
* Load templates for simplified order creation
* Quick and efficient invoicing and payroll



#### For-Hire Fleets

Truckload or LTL, complex load structures, fast customer invoicing, ELD integartions, and more!
* Support for complex LTL load structures
* Customer and lane-level reporting
* Dynamic rate types for invoicing and driver and carrier pay
* Many ELD integrations
* Bolt Driver App with workflow
[Bolt Reporting]

Put your data to work

## Reporting to drive actionable insight

Use our powerful business intelligence tools and reporting capabilities to create efficiencies in
your freight operations and automate workflows.

# Based in Nashville,
# built in the cloud

Bolt is a fully cloud-based platform, accessible via web browser on any device with an internet
connection. You’re in the business of managing trucks, not servers, so we’ll handle the work of
keeping your data safe and your system performant.

As a Bolt client, you’ll have direct access to our team of fleet experts. They stand ready with

# **AT REDGO WE ARE:**


## Committed to Customer Satisfaction

Quick quote response times.


## Fast and On Time Deliveries

REDGO delivers efficently without any hidden fees or frustration


## Hassle Free

We make the shipment booking process simple and convenient. We can help with all your freight needs
and deliver quality communication along the way.

# **Expect the best from Redgo.
# **

# **TRUSTED BY OVER 1,000 CLIENTS**

With over 32 years in business, a dedicated team of professionals, experienced drivers and the most
reliable up-to-date equipment, REDGO delivers with consistency.

[ GET A QUOTE ][11]

**"Dedicated and reliable!!**

That's how I'd sum up Redgo trucking and the exceptional service they have provided to Crystal
Cabinet Works and our customers. Redgo Trucking has always been courteous, honest, open, responsive
and willing to do what it takes to provide a very specialized delivery service."

# **Services:**


## LTL / VOLUME LTL

Less than truckload freight shipping (LTL) is for freight that does not require an entire truckload.
Many times this is small freight on a pallet. Volume LTL is usually greater than 6 pallets.


## FULL TRUCKLOADS

Full Truck Load (FTL) is the transportation of goods that fill up a full truck or even a partial
load being shipped occupying an entire truck. Overloads can ship LTL or volume LTL.


## ELD & HOS

Electronic logging device (ELD) is an electronic solution that allows professional truck drivers and
commercial motor carriers to efficiently record and track their hours of service.

# **Our Clients:**


# **FOR SHIPPERS:**

## Ship with confidence.

Our shipping services keep your business on track and on time. Our reliable, professional and
experienced team gets your product where it needs to be, when it needs to be there. Call today for
more information or request a free estimate.


## **FOR BROKERS:**

## A company to count on.

Your clients and our dedicated team of experienced drivers and staff combine to create a reliable,
professional service you can count on time and time again. At Redgo we know when your clients are
...


## **FOR CARRIERS:**

## A team to be proud of.

Our fleet of drivers is the core of our success. We know the importance of providing a safe,
enjoyable and productive workplace means success for our employees and our business. Join our team
today -- find more info and apply today. Click ["APPLY NOW"][12] or download our application. Mobile
users please print or use a desktop computer to complete the form.

[ APPLY NOW ][13]
[ DOWNLOAD FORM ][14]

**We hire the finest. We hire Vets.**

# **Careers.**

# Redgo is always looking for ambitious individuals who are ready to bring their talents to our
# growing team. We welcome all applicants and look forward to hearing from you.


## HIRING DRIVERS

To join our highly paid team click the APPLY NOW button and follow the steps.


## ARMYPAYS.COM

We hire former military and civil service applicants. Learn more.


## HIRING ADMIN

Our service administration team is one of the best and most tight knit teams in the industry. Apply
to join.

 


## HIRING BROKERS

Experienced brokers and those with the gumption to join an incredible team. Apply now!


## HIRING SERVICE TECHS

Service technicians who have worked in the freight industry are welcome.


## HIRING OWNER OPERATORS

Competitive packages are available to start now. Driver teams are welcome to apply by email or
calling Redgo for an interview.

[ APPLY NOW ][15]
[ DOWNLOAD FORM ][16]

## ****


## **Our Company**

We are a family-owned business that was started in 1986 by James L. Schwehr Sr., Betty Labor, and
Jim L. Schwehr Jr., with just two trucks. Today, our fleet has grown to 25 trucks. In 2003 we lost
Betty to cancer. She was an important part of who we are and every one of our trailers has her name
on it to this day.

In 2012, Jim Sr. retired and Jim Jr., along with his wife, Debi, purchased Redgo. This is how we
became Done Right Trucking Inc. DBA Redgo.

Our drivers are second to none and run only late model equipment. We handle dry vans, pneumatics,
step-decks and RGNS. Our dispatch team and office staff are top-notch and are committed to meeting
your requests. We hope you'll choose Done Right for your transportation needs.

## ****

## **Award winning.**

Redgo is proud to be the first trucking company in Western Montana to partner with the Veteran's
hiring program. It is our honor to hire those who have served our country, and we are privileged to
work with the country's finest.

 

 

 

 

 

### We run all new Kenworth T680’s

[https://youtu.be/Zjih29L2nNo][17]

# Enterprise Transportation Intelligence Platform

Elevating Logistics with Real-time Visibility & Smart Technology

[ Know More ][25]

## AI, ML & IoT-Powered Transport Management

Transform your logistics operations with AI, Machine Learning (ML), and IoT-driven Transport
Management Solutions (TMS). Our intelligent platform ensures real-time visibility, predictive
analytics, and automation, enabling efficient fleet utilization, reduced costs, and enhanced
decision-making.

### Real-Time Fleet Visibility

IoT-enabled GPS and SIM-based tracking provide live location updates and prevent unauthorized
movements.

### Predictive Analytics & Forecasting

AI-driven insights anticipate delays, optimize routes, and reduce downtime.

### Automated Alerts & Exceptions

Real-time ML algorithms detect anomalies in fuel consumption, vehicle health, and driver behavior.

### Dynamic Route Optimization

AI processes traffic, weather, and historical data to suggest the most efficient delivery routes.

### Seamless Integration

IoT-enabled systems sync with SAP ERP, TMS, and other logistics platforms for automated dispatching
and compliance.

### Fuel & Cost Optimization

AI analyzes fuel usage patterns, prevents pilferage, and suggests cost-saving measures.

### Driver Monitoring & Safety

ML-powered Driver Monitoring Systems detect fatigue, distractions, and risky driving behaviors in
real time.

### Payment Solutions

Experience transformative advantages with our payment solution.

## Built for the entire logistics ecosystem

Tailored solutions for every stakeholder in the supply chain

### Fleet Owners

Manage and monitor your trucks effortlessly.

### Booking Agents

Match loads with available trucks.

### Shippers

Get accurate delivery estimates and updates.

### Drivers

Receive clear instructions and fair payments.

### Businesses

Ensure reliable logistics with verified data.

## Seamless Integration

With major ERPs and tools

### India's 1st Unified Trucking Platform

[API Integration Flowchart]

ektruck is designed to streamline logistics operations by seamlessly integrating with all major ERP
systems and industry tools. Whether it's SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or custom-built enterprise
solutions, ektruck ensures real-time data flow for efficient order management, inventory tracking,
freight optimization, and financial reconciliation.

By bridging the gap between logistics and enterprise systems, ektruck enhances visibility, automates
workflows, reduces manual interventions, and enables data-driven decision-making. Its API-driven
architecture allows effortless plug-and-play connectivity, ensuring businesses can leverage their
existing infrastructure while maximizing efficiency and control over their trucking operations.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

#### 6925 Commercial Avenue
#### Billings, MT 59101

## **SERVING 48 STATES SINCE 1946.**

Hi-Ball Trucking specializes in open deck over-the-road transportation. We offer a suite of services
that include OTR, maxi, heavy haul, and an in-house freight brokerage. Based in Billings, Montana
and run by the Smith family for generations, we guarantee quality customer service with safe,
certified, efficient trucking. With offices in both Billings, MT and Bozeman, MT we are here to help
and pride ourselves on running a fleet of quality equipment backed by a staff with years of
experience.

## OUR SERVICES
* OVER THE ROAD
  
  Hi-Ball Trucking is equipped with an over the road fleet of flatbeds and step decks. These are 3
  axle tractors with spread axle step decks and flats that can all scale 48,000 lbs or more in all
  48 states
* HEAVY HAUL
  
  Need heavy machinery moved with ground pickup and delivery? Hi-Ball has you covered with a variety
  of multi-axle combinations to handle machinery up to 100,000 pounds.
* MAXI
  
  Hi-Ball offers a fleet of maxi flatbed and maxi step deck trailers. All of our maxi set ups are 4
  axle trailers and 4 axle trucks and can handle payloads up to 68,000 pounds (state dependent).
* BROKERAGE
  
  Bonded and insured, we only broker to trusted carriers that are put through a strict vetting and
  onboarding process.

[ Learn more ][25]

# RED & READY TO HAUL

## OUR HISTORY

#### ***75 years of trucking and customer service.***

**HI-BALL TRUCKING** traces its beginning to May 22, 1946 when Bill Fisher bought the oilfield
 operation known as The Galloping Swede from the former Governor of Montana, J. Hugo Aronson.
 Having operated in the area of Cut Bank, MT sine 1932, the business continued in Cut Bank, only
under  a new name of HI-BALL CONTRACTORS. Wanting to maintain the colorful image Aronson had
operated under, Bill named the company after an old railroad term “Hi-Ball” used to tell the train
on the track that a stop was not needed in the next town and they could continue on at full speed.  

In 1948, **HI-BALL TRUCKING** moved to Billings, MT and in 1956 it became one of the first USA
carriers to apply for and receive operating authority from Alberta, Canada. **HI-BALL TRUCKING** was
also the first trucking company to service the new oil fields in Alaska at this time. The trucks
were driven to Fairbanks and loaded onto planes for a final destination to Brooks, Alaska.  

Perhaps the most interesting service **HI-BALL TRUCKING** provided was in 1961 when four trucks were
sent overseas to the Spanish Sahara Desert for 8 months of oilfield service - hauling over 6 million
pounds of equipment on nothing more than a track of sand.

Harold J. Lohrenz bought the company in 1969 and incorporated it to **HI-BALL TRUCKING, INC. **and
operated it for the next 16 years. On May 21, 1985, Ron Smith bought the company and broadened the
authority to include all commodities and all states, including Hawaii. Operating authority was
granted from the Province of British Columbia in 1990. Ron’s son, Trent Smith, would then become the
owner in March of 1994. Although once confined to working the oilfields of Montana and nearby
states, **HI-BALL TRUCKING** could now transport extensively in the USA and Canada for both the
public and the United States Department of Defense.  

After successfully owning **HI-BALL TRUCKING** for 31 years, Trent Smith sold the company to his
son, Tanner Smith, on January 1, 2025 to continue the Smith legacy in the trucking industry. With
the purchase of **HI-BALL TRUCKING**, Tanner became the 5th generation in the Smith family to
operate a trucking company.

Bill Fisher chose not to name the company after himself, hoping it would continue long after his
name ever could. **HI-BALL TRUCKING** has indeed stood the test of time across multiple generations
and ownership changes and has been built on a strong foundation of efficacy and professionalism.
**HI-BALL TRUCKING** looks forward to continuing full speed ahead far into the future, keeping
stride with the constant changes hitting the road each year.

HotShotTrucking.com has the logistical expertise, massive network and resources to move any hot shot
shipment under last-minute deadlines. We build the customized shipping strategy your supply chain
demands.

HotShotTrucking.com leverages a global network to expedite your freight via ground or air. We find
the fastest route to your destination, no matter the obstacle.

Choose from our complete hotshot trucking lineup of semi-trucks, flatbeds, and sprinter vans. We
offer everything from standard tractor-trailers to specialized air charter services to keep your
supply chain moving.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR SERVICES][41]

[sprinter-vans]

### Sprinter Vans

When speed counts but you don’t want to break the cost barrier, cargo Sprinter vans are an excellent
option for your expedited freight. We provide a broad selection of Sprinter vans to support both
local and long-distance ground shipping needs.

[ Sprinter Van Services ][42]
[box-trucks]

### Box Trucks

Small box trucks range from 10 to 16 feet long, larger than Sprinter vans but smaller than large box
trucks and semi-trailers. Secure your urgent shipment immediately. We deploy vetted vehicles to
ensure your freight arrives safely, securely, and strictly on time.

[large-straight-trucks-1]

### Large Straight Trucks

Scale up your capacity significantly beyond a standard van. Large straight trucks handle
time-sensitive cargo and palletized freight with ease. Consult our expeditors to maximize your
efficiency. We identify the ideal ground transportation vehicle to match your specific load
requirements.

[ Straight Truck Services ][44]
[53-ft-dry-vans-1]

### 53' Dry Vans

We offer access to 53-foot dry vans capable of handling loads up to 44,000 pounds, providing
door-to-door service through authorized motor carriers across the USA, Canada, and Mexico. These
53-foot dry vans are perfect for transporting various freight types, such as palletized goods,
non-perishable items, and other sizable loads.

[ Dry Van Services ][45]
[flatbed-trucks]

### Flatbed Trucking Services

We provide flexible flatbed trucking services tailored to meet urgent deadlines, with the
convenience of a dedicated point of contact and real-time tracking. Whether you’re shipping
construction materials, machinery, or industrial equipment, our expeditors ensure fast, reliable
transport to the final destination.

[ Full Flatbed Services ][46]
[hot-shot-truck]

### Hot Shot Trucking

Our hotshot trucking services are equipped to handle wide or oversized hot shot loads, as well as
specialized equipment for local, regional, or national deliveries. Get in touch with our experienced
team of expeditors to get a freight quote now.

[ Hot Shot Trucking Services ][47]

At HotShotTrucking.com, we specialize in dedicated trucking solutions that move urgent freight
directly from pickup to delivery with no delays or transfers.

# PROFESSIONALISM, PRIDE, & INTEGRITY
# Drives Jones Bros to deliver quality service to our customers and a solid future to our employees.

**Jones Brothers Trucking delivers on its commitments—every load, every time.**

With terminals in **Missoula, Montana and Muncie, Indiana**, we operate as an irregular route
flatbed carrier across all 48 states and into Canada. Our success is built on experienced
leadership, well-trained drivers, and a culture that prioritizes safety, accountability, and
professionalism.

We take pride in doing things the right way—delivering reliable service and consistent results for
every customer we serve.

*Don’t sweat the logistics, we’ve got you covered!*

Speak with a rep:

1-800-877-1075

[GET A QUOTE!][8]

Each Jones Brothers Trucking flatbed combination is equipped to haul a minimum of **48,000 lbs** and
comes fully outfitted with **8-foot lumber tarps, 4-foot steel tarps, straps, chains, and binders**
to properly secure a wide range of freight.

What truly sets us apart is our people.

Every member of our dispatch, sales, and management team began their career at Jones Brothers
Trucking behind the wheel—spending up to a year on the road learning the job firsthand. This
experience creates a level of understanding that can’t be taught in an office.

Our team knows the realities of flatbed trucking—weather, terrain, regulations, and time
constraints—because they’ve lived it. That perspective allows us to make better decisions,
communicate more effectively, and deliver a higher level of service to both our drivers and
customers.

We’re always on the lookout to add exceptional personnel to our fleet. Whether you’re a veteran road

### InterIsland Logistics

Connecting the Islands of the Philippines

The Philippines is an archipelago of over 7,000 islands — and that makes transportation a unique
challenge. Unlike in landlocked countries where a postman in a van might suffice, moving goods and
people here requires a more intricate solution. Millions of Filipinos depend on a complex
inter-island shipping and transport system to stay connected.

Throughout history, the development of an efficient transportation network has been essential to the
Philippines’ economic growth. Reliable and cost-effective logistics are critical for the movement of
goods, services, and people across the country’s diverse regions.

Seamless Inter-Island Cargo Solutions with JRMT Logistics

At JRMT Logistics, we specialize in bridging the gaps between islands and regions with dependable,
affordable cargo solutions. Our services include:
* Short-sea shipping
* Roll-on/Roll-off (RoRo) transport
* Integrated land-sea-air logistics networks

Whether you’re moving perishables, construction materials, or consumer goods, we ensure smooth,
timely, and secure delivery across the archipelago. With JRMT, the islands are closer than ever.

[ Read More ][73]
[ Contact Us ][74]

Air freight is the fastest and most efficient mode of international shipping, ideal for high-value,
perishable, or time-sensitive goods such as pharmaceuticals, electronics, and critical spare parts.
With transit times as short as 24–48 hours, it supports businesses that depend on speed and
precision.

While air freight comes at a higher cost due to fuel, airport fees, and weight limitations, its
reliability and speed make it essential for time-critical logistics.

With transit times as short as 24–48 hours, it supports businesses that depend on speed and

While air freight comes at a higher cost due to fuel, airport fees, and weight limitations, its

partnerships with major carriers, we ensure:

* Seamless integration with land and sea logistics

### Sea Freight Transportation

Sea freight, also known as ocean freight, is a cost-effective and reliable method for transporting
goods across long distances. It involves shipping cargo via container vessels, with flexible options
to suit different shipment sizes:
* Full Container Load (FCL) – ideal for large shipments that occupy an entire container
* Less than Container Load (LCL) – suitable for smaller shipments that share space with other cargo

Despite challenges such as port congestion and weather-related delays, sea freight remains the most
environmentally sustainable shipping method, generating fewer emissions per ton-mile than air or
road transport.

At JRMT Logistics, we provide integrated sea freight solutions combined with land-based logistics to
ensure seamless intermodal transport — delivering your cargo efficiently from port to final
destination.

[ Read More ][77]
[ Contact Us ][78]

### Land Freight Transportation

Land freight transportation refers to the movement of goods by road and, in some countries, by rail.
It plays a vital role in supply chains, supporting local, regional, and inter-island distribution.
This mode includes trucking, bus cargo, and intermodal solutions, offering flexibility for
door-to-door deliveries, especially over short to medium distances.

In the Philippines, where rail transport is not available, JRMT Logistics utilizes dedicated bus
lanes for efficient cargo movement nationwide. For Full Truck Load (FTL) shipments, we operate our
own fleet — from 4-wheeler to 6-wheeler trucks — capable of handling warehouse-to-warehouse
deliveries with speed and reliability.

# Payments, tax & subscriptions for software companies

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

ecommerce

## Create the perfect buying experience for your customers

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

[
e/1

### Accept online payments

Don't worry about merchant accounts and billing logic. **Choose per seat, usage-based and more**.
Customize as little or as much as you like.

][33][
e/2

### Recurring billing + subscriptions

Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and
cancels**. Offer free trials, discounts, and more.

][34][
e/3

### License key management

Automatically issue license keys for your software and apps after each sale. **Deactivate, re-issue,
and have full control** over license management.

][35][
e/4

### Sell digital downloads

Anyone can provide download links, but what about security and abuse? Your **download links are
securely signed**, throttled, and more.

][36][
e/5

### No-code checkout forms

No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique
checkout links** and sell anywhere.

][37][
e/6

### Launch your ecommerce store

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

][38]
marketing

## Grow your business with integrated marketing tools

Grow your audience, build long-lasting customer relationships, and make more sales with **powerful,
easy-to-use marketing tools**. Whether you need to offer discount codes or you want to build your
email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

[
M/1

### Ocean & Air Import Export

Mecca Worldwide Logistics is fully licensed and ready to meet your global shipping needs. Mecca

### Port Drayage

Serving Northeast US ports including Port Newark, Elizabeth, Bayonne, New Jersey, New York,
Philadelphia and Baltimore. Maher, APM, PNCT, Port Liberty, Packer and Seagirt. Mecca offers import
export container transport, transload, cross dock, heavy lift and more -- streamlined to eliminate
costly per diem and demurrage fees. Mecca provides real-time tracking and expert handling of port
regulations, scheduling and more.

[Drayage]

### Trucking

Mecca & Son Trucking is your asset based trucking and transportation solution for the Northeast
Regional USA. From LTL to full truckload, crates to coils, Mecca features a diverse equipment
profile geared to handling any of your trucking requirements. We ensure your freight is safe in
transit and delivered on time, keeping your supply chain running smoothly. Trust Mecca to move
anything and everything, whenever you need it.

[Warehouse]

### Warehousing

Mecca offers a variety of freight storage and handling solutions for New York and New Jersey. Our
port centralized warehouses are ideal hubs for transloading and crossdocking for those quick turn
arounds and long term storage for a safe and clean stay. Bonded, CFS, dry, refrigerated, food and
beverage including liquor licensed, Mecca is also AIB certified and a member of the ICE Coffee
Exchange. Mecca handles it all.

[Forklift]

### Transloading

Transload and Crossdocking provide clients a way to cut cost and keep freight moving quick and easy.
Our transload services will get your source freight offloaded and transferred to carrier trailer
direct while crossdock provides a less then 24 hour short term dock stay. Heavy lift capacity
available for those bigger assignments including open top, flat rack and more. Save on per diem and
demmurage costs today with our east coast transload and cross dock service.

[Logistics]

### Logistics

Looking to transport freight outside of the Northeast USA? Mecca Worldwide Logistics, our brokerage
arm, expands our coverage window utilizing many industry resources to provide nationwide 3PL
services coast to coast. Truckload, LTL, and out of area warehousing and freight solutions are just
a click or call away.

handling, efficiency and to maximize the bottom line.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

[Montana Trucking Safety]

The Montana Trucking Association has been pivotal in our accomplishments as a safe and viable motor
carrier. Access to both state and federal legislation has provided us with an industry voice and a
seat at the table as we navigate an ever-changing regulatory and economic environment. Working
together with other Montana motor carriers and suppliers to advance our industry is critical to our
successful future.


Michael  Wilson -  Whitewood Transport, Inc.

Now, more than ever, being proactive and promoting a safety-minded culture is key to the success of
our professional drivers and the carriers they work for. We appreciate the value and priority that
the Montana Trucking Association places on advocating safety through training and collaboration. We
are all in this for the long haul. Stay safe and arrive alive!


Jason Sorlien - Marsh McLennan Agency

[Montana Trucking]
[Montana Trucking Association]

Having done business with and being part of the Montana Trucking Association for the past 30 years,
Hanson Trucking has come to rely on the professionalism and positive outlook they provide. In the
ever-changing business arena we all work in, being proactive for the members of the MTA along with
the Montana public is key to keeping business operating in compliance with all regulations and
keeping all on our public highways safe. MTA touches all aspects of doing business in Montana. From
planting seeds in the ground to transporting wind turbines across our state, to assisting in the
transportation training of our high school students, MTA is there. We look forward to another 30
years of partnership with the MTA!!
 
Steve Hanson – Hanson Trucking Inc.

* Students must be an employee or the dependent of an employee of a MTA Member to be eligible.

## MTA is Dedicated to serving 
## hardworking members.

Montana Trucking Association is comprised of over 300 trucking companies and important industry
suppliers working to meet the needs of the trucking industry in Montana through education,
legislative advice, and lobbying on behalf of the trucking industry. 

Jason Sorlien

[Montana Trucking]

[Montana Trucking Association]

[Montana Trucking]

Feel Supported!

[Montana Trucking Safety]

The Montana Trucking Association has been pivotal in our accomplishments as a safe and viable motor
carrier. Access to both state and federal legislation has provided us with an industry voice and a
seat at the table as we navigate an ever-changing regulatory and economic environment. Working
together with other Montana motor carriers and suppliers to advance our industry is critical to our
successful future.


Michael  Wilson -  Whitewood Transport, Inc.

Now, more than ever, being proactive and promoting a safety-minded culture is key to the success of
our professional drivers and the carriers they work for. We appreciate the value and priority that
the Montana Trucking Association places on advocating safety through training and collaboration. We
are all in this for the long haul. Stay safe and arrive alive!


Jason Sorlien - Marsh McLennan Agency

[Montana Trucking]
[Montana Trucking Association]

Having done business with and being part of the Montana Trucking Association for the past 30 years,
Hanson Trucking has come to rely on the professionalism and positive outlook they provide. In the
ever-changing business arena we all work in, being proactive for the members of the MTA along with
the Montana public is key to keeping business operating in compliance with all regulations and
keeping all on our public highways safe. MTA touches all aspects of doing business in Montana. From
planting seeds in the ground to transporting wind turbines across our state, to assisting in the
transportation training of our high school students, MTA is there. We look forward to another 30
years of partnership with the MTA!!
 
Steve Hanson – Hanson Trucking Inc.

* Montana students completing their senior year in high school or are currently enrolled in a
  Montana college and working toward an undergraduate degree.
* Students must be an employee or the dependent of an employee of a MTA Member to be eligible.
* The student must be a Montana resident planning to attend a Montana college, University, Trade

[Artboard 17]

### Founded in 1970

From just a single truck to one of
America’s largest freight trucking operations & transport

### Sustainable

Prime is proud to go green and protect the environment

### Prime values

Serving our customers
while treating our associates well

#### Why Choose Prime?

## Your Trucking Partner

Since our founding in 1970, Prime has been an innovative regional and Over the Road (OTR) trucking
company, paving the way for the rest of the trucking industry. Explore our history, equipment,
facilities and one-of-a-kind company culture. 

[ Explore Prime ][20]

#### Transportation & logistics services

## deliver farther

Ship your goods domestic with Prime, one of North America’s largest and most successful
refrigerated, flatbed, tanker and intermodal freight carriers. Whether your truckload is
time-critical, delicate, temperature-sensitive, liquid or solid perishable goods or durable
construction materials, we have a transportation solution for you.

[ Explore More ][21]

#### Drive for Prime

## Start Your Career

Become a part of the fleet that keeps America rolling. We’re proud to say that Prime is one of the
best places for truck drivers to work in the country. When you become a driver for Prime, you can
earn a living while seeing the beauty of the country from right outside your window. Whether you’re
a new driver who needs CDL training or a more experienced driver we encourage you to become a part
of the Prime family.

[ Get Started ][22]

### 9,000+

Truck Drivers Nationwide

### 24/7/365

Live support available around the clock.

### top pay

We offer industry leading pay

## Prime Mobile App

#### A time saving tool to help keep drivers connected and informed.

[ [Get it on Google Play button.] ][23]
[ [Download on the app store button.] ][24]
[A digital drawing of a semi-truck and trailer various icons sitting above.]

### 1,800+

Non-Drivers. It takes a lot of people to keep us moving

### Join prime

Now hiring nationwide. Join the Prime family

[Performance Improvement]

### Benefits

Incentive pay. Pay for performance

#### Work in House

## Advance your career

Behind each Prime driver is a fleet of in-house associates ensuring the safety, success and
reliability of our operations. Learn more about in-house job opportunities and the associates that
keep Prime moving. 

[ Discover Prime Careers ][25]

#### prime brokerage

## your truck, your trailer

Increase your earnings while spending less on overhead when you book loads through Prime’s vast
freight network. Get pre-qualified today! 

[ Explore prime brokerage ][26]
[A white Prime, Inc. truck pulling a refrigerated trailer with the word "Your Truck" and "Your
Trailer" above it.]
[A white Prime, Inc. Power Fleet truck pulling a refrigerated trailer with the word "Your Truck" and
"Prime's Trailer" above it.]

#### prime power fleet

## your truck, prime's trailer

Run more profitable loads with less equipment to buy. Power Fleet leverages your own authority and
responsiveness along with Prime’s large company capacity and freight network. 

[ Explore power fleet ][27]

#### success leasing

## Lease the best

Get on the road in the latest model truck with the lowest operating costs. We’ll get you going and
set you up for success in your very own truck.

[ Explore success leasing ][28]

#### pedigree

## Own the best

Pedigree Truck & Trailer Sales is your source for used semi-trucks that have been owned and
maintained by Prime. Choose from trucks and trailers of every color and size you could imagine, each
expertly fleet-maintained since its first day on the road. Sell a truck, expand your fleet or start
on the road with a truck that’s all your own.

[ Discover pedigree ][29]

#### More questions? reach out

## Contact us

#### Why Choose Prime?

## Your Trucking Partner

Since our founding in 1970, Prime has been an innovative regional and Over the Road (OTR) trucking
company, paving the way for the rest of the trucking industry. Explore our history, equipment,
facilities and one-of-a-kind company culture.

#### Transportation & logistics services

## deliver farther

Ship your goods domestic with Prime, one of North America’s largest and most successful
refrigerated, flatbed, tanker and intermodal freight carriers. Whether your truckload is
time-critical, delicate, temperature-sensitive, liquid or solid perishable goods or durable
construction materials, we have a transportation solution for you.

[ Explore More ][21]

#### Drive for Prime

## Start Your Career

Become a part of the fleet that keeps America rolling. We’re proud to say that Prime is one of the
best places for truck drivers to work in the country. When you become a driver for Prime, you can
earn a living while seeing the beauty of the country from right outside your window. Whether you’re
a new driver who needs CDL training or a more experienced driver we encourage you to become a part
of the Prime family.

[ Get Started ][22]

Get on the road in the latest model truck with the lowest operating costs. We’ll get you going and

# Search Trucking Companies - USA, Canada & Mexico

QuickTSI is the free online directory for the trucking industry. Search carrier profiles by state,
city, zip code or USDOT number - view contact info, safety records, inspection reports, cargo hauled
and more. We also help owner-operators find truck driving jobs, locate CDL medical examiners,
compare freight brokers, and get same-day pay through freight factoring.

## Search USA Trucking Companies

View detailed carrier information including contact info, office address, total trucks, total truck
drivers, cargo hauled, safety records, inspection reports, crash reports and more.

## Truck Driving Jobs Near You

Are you an Owner Operator or Driver looking for work? QuickTSI provides access to truck driving jobs
from companies such as Schneider, Swift, CRST Malone, J.B. Hunt, Werner Enterprises, Mcleod Express,
Heartland Express, Melton Truck Lines and more. Start your search for [truck driving jobs][37] in
major US cities today!

[View Truck Driving Jobs »][38]

## Trucking & Logistics Supplies

Cargo Control and Load Securement Equipment. Top quality products. Buy direct. Ships to your door.
LogiPro Supplies is your go-to store for reliable [supplies for logistics and trucking
companies][39]. Decking Beams, Chains, Straps, Ratchets, Hooks, Load Bars and much more.

[Trucking & Logistics Supplies »][40]

## Find CDL Physical Medical Examiners

FMCSA regulations require interstate commercial [truck drivers][41] to carry a DOT medical
certificate. The exam must be performed by a certified medical examiner on the FMCSA National
Registry. QuickTSI helps commercial truck drivers find a CDL Physical Exam Location near them.

[View CDL Medical Examiners »][42]


## Freight Factoring Companies

A lack of cash flow is the #1 reason trucking companies fail. Freight factoring lets you convert
unpaid invoices into same-day cash - stop waiting 30-60 days for shippers to pay. QuickTSI has a
directory of freight factoring companies serving the US trucking industry.

[View Factoring Companies »][43]

## Find Freight Brokers by State

Freight brokers are federally licensed and bonded intermediaries who connect shippers with carriers.
QuickTSI provides information on freight brokers across major US cities including [California][44],
[Texas][45], [Florida][46], [New York][47], and [Ohio][48].

[View Freight Brokers »][49]

## Truck Driving Schools

Looking to start a career as a truck driver? Find CDL truck driving schools near you in
[California][50], [Texas][51], [Florida][52], [Pennsylvania][53] and more.

[View Trucking Schools »][54]

## Daily Fuel Prices

Fuel is one of the biggest operating costs in trucking. Stay current on fuel prices so you can make
smarter decisions at the pump.

[View Fuel Prices »][55]

## Truck & Trailer Wash Locations

Find a truck wash near you at home or on the road across all major US cities and states.

[Find Wash Locations »][56]

## Cargo & Liability Insurance

Compare cargo and liability insurance companies across the US. QuickTSI provides a wide range of
insurers to choose from whether you're signing up for the first time or switching providers.

[View Insurance Companies »][57]

## QuickTSI Trucking Blog

The QuickTSI Trucking Blog covers topics for trucking companies and owner operators - how to get
your CDL, choosing a factoring company, trucking industry news, fuel saving tips and more.

[View Trucking Blog »][58]

Södertälje, Sweden. The company focuses on commercial vehicles for long-distance haulage,
construction and distribution, and also produces engines for marine and industrial applications.]

# Welcome to Scania

Our purpose is to drive the shift towards a sustainable transport system, creating a world of
mobility that is better for business, society and the environment.

[Scania Irizar i6s PHEV 3-axle]

## [New 11-litre Super powertrain for buses and coaches][12]

Building on the launch of our 13-litre Super powertrain for people transport, we are now expanding
the platform with a new 11-litre option — the Super 11 — designed to meet the demands of both urban
and travel operations. Our new bus and coach powertrain platform delivers up to 10% fuel savings,
and 40% lower emissions with plug-in hybrid capability. Based on the award-winning Super technology,
it ensures an efficient and flexible solution for modern transport operations.

[ Discover the new powertrain ][13]

## Euro NCAP awards Scania L-cab and P-cab top safety ratings in the utility and distribution
## segment

[Scania L series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ L-series trucks ][14]

The L-cab for utility operations is a versatile low-entry cab designed for urban and vocational use.
It combines active safety systems, including advanced emergency braking, with passive protection
such as driver and side-curtain airbags.

[ Road safety at Scania ][15]
[Scania P series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ P-series trucks ][16]

The P-cab for distribution combines high driving position with strong all-round visibility. It
achieved the highest score in [Euro NCAP][17]’s “CitySafe” category, recognising vehicles equipped
with features designed to prevent accidents in urban environments.

[ Press release ][18]
