sustainable transport and growth in the world’s largest truck market.

[ [Scania truck on a road summertime] ][22]

#### [Scania Performance Summary Q2][23]

Scania performed strongly during the second quarter of 2026. Truck order intake increased
significantly, vehicle deliveries rose and service revenues continued to grow compared with the same
period last year. 

[ [Autonomous truck sensor] ][24]

#### [Autonomous trucks can help address transport industry’s driver shortage issue][25]

Will driverless vehicles reduce the need for human drivers? At Scania, we believe technology and
people will complement each other.

[ [An electric Scania truck for bulk transport.] ][26]

#### [Scania in landmark deal to sell 105 battery-electric trucks to Wibax][27]

Scania has signed a landmark deal with Wibax for 105 battery-electric trucks, helping scale
sustainable bulk transport across the Nordic region.

[ Go to our newsroom ][28]

### Scania introduces - the new Super 11-litre engine

Scania launches a new member in the Scania Super family – the Super 11 engine. A lighter, more
efficient solution for high-performance transport. With a compact footprint, up to 7 percent fuel
savings and Scania’s signature engineering intelligence, the new Super 11 engine expands the Super
powertrain portfolio to meet the needs of weight-sensitive and energy-efficient applications.

ambitious journey to drive the shift towards sustainable transport.

# Welcome to Scania

Our purpose is to drive the shift towards a sustainable transport system, creating a world of
mobility that is better for business, society and the environment.

[Scania Irizar i6s PHEV 3-axle]

## [New 11-litre Super powertrain for buses and coaches][12]

Building on the launch of our 13-litre Super powertrain for people transport, we are now expanding
the platform with a new 11-litre option — the Super 11 — designed to meet the demands of both urban
and travel operations. Our new bus and coach powertrain platform delivers up to 10% fuel savings,
and 40% lower emissions with plug-in hybrid capability. Based on the award-winning Super technology,
it ensures an efficient and flexible solution for modern transport operations.

[ Discover the new powertrain ][13]

## Euro NCAP awards Scania L-cab and P-cab top safety ratings in the utility and distribution
## segment

[Scania L series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ L-series trucks ][14]

The L-cab for utility operations is a versatile low-entry cab designed for urban and vocational use.
It combines active safety systems, including advanced emergency braking, with passive protection
such as driver and side-curtain airbags.

[ Road safety at Scania ][15]
[Scania P series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ P-series trucks ][16]

The P-cab for distribution combines high driving position with strong all-round visibility. It
achieved the highest score in [Euro NCAP][17]’s “CitySafe” category, recognising vehicles equipped
with features designed to prevent accidents in urban environments.

sustainable transport and growth in the world’s largest truck market.

[ [Scania truck on a road summertime] ][22]

Scania performed strongly during the second quarter of 2026. Truck order intake increased
significantly, vehicle deliveries rose and service revenues continued to grow compared with the same
period last year. 

[ [Autonomous truck sensor] ][24]

# Find the best Freight Quote

[logo]

Exclusive NVOCC service from China to Mediterranean

Explore new opportunities for cargo carriage from China to Turkey and North Africa. Access SeaRates
by DP World logistics network for profitable and optimized supplies through the regions' leading
ports.

[ Learn more ][80]

Freight Calculation and Online Bookings

Obtain fair tariffs and spot rates via **online Freight Calculator** for your sea/air/land shipments
and parcels over 190+ countries. Get cargo space guarantees with an instant **online booking**.
Integrate API to promote your rates and services with booking processing management.

[img-1/]

Extensive Tracking System

**Track** your sea/air/land shipments and parcels **in real-time**. Trace cargo movement, global
trade lanes, and routes to control supply chain. Get your own tracking tool with **smooth API
integration** to provide a full-fledged solution for optimized logistics and trade.

[img-2/]
[logo]

Exclusive Unifeeder network

Access a network of feeder and shortsea **in Europe**, **Middle and Far East.** Efficient and
sustainable transport solutions have become more affordable.

[ Show more ][81]
[logo]

P&O coverage

Get access to a leading provider of multimodal logistics solutions with an industry focus via **P&O
Ferrymasters, Ferries, and Maritime Logistics** — by land, rivers and sea.

[ Show more ][82]
[img-4/]

Exclusive space from China to the USA

On a tough FCL market SeaRates offers **the most competitive shipping rates** with guaranteed space
from China, direct from the global freight forwarding community.

Our team will help you find quotes, buy insurance, and plan your end-to-end shipping journey.

[ Show more ][83]

Our team will help you find quotes, buy insurance, and plan your end-to-end shipping journey.

[ Show more ][83]
[img-5/]

Personal dashboard

See and manage all your processes in one dashboard on the desktop or in the mobile app! Control your
**bookings, contracts, finance,** and all other features needed for managing logistics in your
trading business. Get the full seamless experience of the log-tech!

[ Show more ][84]
[img-6/]

Special rates for contracts for 6+ months!

If you contract with us for **6 months** or more with a certain commitment of cargo you will ship —
you are definitely getting lower rates.

[ Show more ][85]
[img-7/]

24/7 all time zones support

Our support teams around the world are ready to pick up your need as quickly as they appear. **Book
with SeaRates** and get a bespoke expert who is available to help 24/7/365. Ship your freight with
confidence!

[ Chat now ][86]
[img-8/]

Cutting edge digital logistics tools

With SeaRates shippers are able to get access to the ultimate ecosystem of applications such as
**rate benchmarking, cargo tracking, route optimization, schedules, paperwork and more!** All of
this is available with SaaS access, API and white-label web integrations.

[ Show more ][87]
[img-9/]

Logistics liability insurance

Thanks to the world's top insurance partners, we will indemnify for any loss, damage, or liability
as to the result of an occurrence arising out of the property incident **up to $50,000,000.**

[ Show more ][88]
[img-10/]

Logistics & Trade Finance solution

Today SeaRates can offer an extensive finance solution to support your international deals. Working
with world's leading **NBFC's through DP World's Finance** we give you deferred payment options for
either logistics services or even payments for the goods.

[ Show more ][89]
[img-11/]

Reduce bank charges on freight

Save on bank fees by arranging your **freight payments** through SeaRates.

[ Show more ][90]
[img-12/]

Word of mouth promo 10% off

Refer us to friends, and we'll give them **5% off** their **1st time booking with SeaRates.** When
they make a booking, you get 5% off, too. (And that goes for every friend you've got.)*

### Services

#### Shipping & logistics

Open up new opportunities for the growth of your business, enter new markets, discover new
continents. We are with you door-to-door.

#### Book & track online

Find diverse solutions for transportation needs of all kinds. Quick and nimble solutions to handle
all your supply chain needs.

#### Digital Technologies

Our priority is to offer a mix of tools and insights for business, no matter the size of your
operation, the volume of your sales or the age of your company.

#### Freight marketplace

We support your goals for growth with cargo insurance, online payments and paperless workflow. Take
the business to the next step.

#### 24/7 Support

Feel the supportive hand of our staff every moment. The acumen of our numerous experts throughout
the world is at your fingertips.

## SeaRates today

The lowest rates. The shortest transit times. SeaRates is the **largest tariff search engine** in
the world for international shipping

We compare all available cargo delivery options at your request and arrange their transportation and
insurance.

We provide **transparency and control,** the **cheapest price** and the **fastest transit time**.

[ About us ][111]
[Golden Gate]
Part of [ [dp world building] ][112]

### Your benefits with SeaRates

#### All in One Shipping

Would you like to ship cargo by ship? FCL or LCL? Bulk or Break Bulk? There is everything you need
for shipping on SeaRates.com. We have gathered the shipping services and put them all in one place
to facilitate your search. Instantly compare ocean and trucking freight quotes from the most popular
logistics providers. **Book everything on one site!**

[Carriers]

#### Save with Loyalty

We value our frequent customers and provide shipping rates with discounts for those who qualify. We
provide **special promotions in the form of promotional codes** depending on your orders & routes.
To get a promo code, fill out the quotation request form.

[loyalty picture]

#### Easy Freight Booking

Affordable pricing of shipping services is what we constantly strive for. At SeaRates.com you will
find **cheap rates to any country,** from the world's top freight forwarders, saving you time and
money. Why spend a lot of resource and energy on negotiations to get the best shipping rate? Find
and book them online at SeaRates.com.

[new request]

#### End-to-End Support

24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year! We understand how important it is to support our
customers while arranging their cargo movement, delivery and customs clearance. Our **Customer Care
Service** is always available to support on all issues relating to freight, weight, routing, rates,
inland haulage and documentation.

# DISTRIBUTOR RESMI MINYAK PERTAMINA

Perusahaan distributor resmi yang bergerak di bidang transportir bahan bakar minyak. Kami dipercaya
melayani kebutuhan distribusi solar dalam sektor industri.

## [ Harga Solar Industri B40 & MFO 15-31 Juli 2026 ][28]

15 July 2026

## [ Harga Solar Industri B40 & MFO 01-14 Juli 2026 ][29]

1 July 2026

## Produk

Sebagai distributor resmi pertamina, kami berfokus pada penjualan dan penyaluran BBM Non Subsidi
untuk kepentingan di sektor industri dan perkapalan.

### Biodiesel B40

Campuran biodiesel dengan komposisi 40% bahan bakar nabati dan 60% solar.

[ Lihat Selengkapnya ][30]

### Marine Fuel Oil

Melayani jasa pengisian bahan bakar kapal laut dan bunker service.

[ Lihat Selengkapnya ][31]

### Tangki Solar Industri

Melayani proses pembuatan dan penyewaan tangki solar untuk industri.

[ Lihat Selengkapnya ][32]

Ikuti perkembangan terbaru seputar sektor perminyakan, energi industri, dan teknologi pendukungnya.

manufaktur.

Campuran biodiesel dengan komposisi 40% bahan bakar nabati dan 60% solar.

##### Recent Comments
* [Nrd515][92] I bought an '88 S10 Blazer with the 4.3 and after a couple of minor issues covered
  under warranty, it was probably the best vehicle I ever had, reliability wise. I sold it to a
  friend when it was just about to hit 60K miles. in 1992, when I bought a Grand Cherokee, which was
  just more comfortable for someone built like a Gorilla(Me). My friend had it for just about 20
  years, it had two transmission rebuilds, the usual water pumps, etc, and a valve job at around
  300K, but it went to the boneyard on the original shortblock at at least 420K, more likely over
  500K as the speedo had died several years before the Blazer did. Oh yeah, it got stolen and was
  found a week later almost vertical in a ditch by a passing train crew. The interior was trashed,
  but a nearly identical looking red S10 at one of the local yards had a nice interior and it was
  back on the road a week after it was recovered. None of his 3 sons were born when he got it, all
  three learned to drive in it. It was scrapped when the winshield/roof area rusted to the point
  that driving it in the rain got you soaked. It was driven to the boneyard, the nearly new battery
  was removed, and put into one of their other vehicles. If only the F150 that replaced it was as
  reliable. It lasted 11 years, with endless transmission and $$$ engine issues. He was done with
  Ford at that point.
* [MRF 95 T-Bird][93] The new JLR GT bears an uncanny resemblance and is like a modernized version
  of the Rover 3500 and Sterling 827i. If they build it hopefully it's not as cursed as they were.
* [Gor65735248][94] Waymo is here in Houston too. I am ready to give up the wheel to a machine.
* [Ivan Washington][95] it did its job in advertising the alpha male quality of its owners to
  prospective mates.
* [Ivan Washington][96] I would rather be a passenger than a driver in today's world. too many fools
  have absolutely ruined the driving experience for me to want to bother with it anymore.

##### Recent Comments
* [Nrd515][92] I bought an '88 S10 Blazer with the 4.3 and after a couple of minor issues covered
  under warranty, it was probably the best vehicle I ever had, reliability wise. I sold it to a
  friend when it was just about to hit 60K miles. in 1992, when I bought a Grand Cherokee, which was
  just more comfortable for someone built like a Gorilla(Me). My friend had it for just about 20
  years, it had two transmission rebuilds, the usual water pumps, etc, and a valve job at around
  300K, but it went to the boneyard on the original shortblock at at least 420K, more likely over
  500K as the speedo had died several years before the Blazer did. Oh yeah, it got stolen and was
  found a week later almost vertical in a ditch by a passing train crew. The interior was trashed,
  but a nearly identical looking red S10 at one of the local yards had a nice interior and it was
  back on the road a week after it was recovered. None of his 3 sons were born when he got it, all
  three learned to drive in it. It was scrapped when the winshield/roof area rusted to the point
  that driving it in the rain got you soaked. It was driven to the boneyard, the nearly new battery
  was removed, and put into one of their other vehicles. If only the F150 that replaced it was as
  reliable. It lasted 11 years, with endless transmission and $$$ engine issues. He was done with
  Ford at that point.
* [MRF 95 T-Bird][93] The new JLR GT bears an uncanny resemblance and is like a modernized version
  of the Rover 3500 and Sterling 827i. If they build it hopefully it's not as cursed as they were.
* [Gor65735248][94] Waymo is here in Houston too. I am ready to give up the wheel to a machine.
* [Ivan Washington][95] it did its job in advertising the alpha male quality of its owners to
  prospective mates.
* [Ivan Washington][96] I would rather be a passenger than a driver in today's world. too many fools
  have absolutely ruined the driving experience for me to want to bother with it anymore.

## All the Best Drivers, Carriers and Vendors finally finding each other…

One of the biggest struggles both trucking companies and drivers face is discovering each other.
Carriers cant find drivers and drivers can’t find the right carrier for them. This heavily affects
driver turnover rates, costing companies and drivers thousands of dollars because they just can’t
find the right fit.

> Drivers, Carriers, and Trucking Industry Service Providers can create their own individual
> professional profiles where they can quickly discover each other and connect instantly.

Trucker Jobs is a platform that was created for the trucking industry to have a one stop networking
hub.

Carriers rely on exceptional service providers to facilitate smooth and efficient daily trucking
operations. Now, carriers can easily discover and connect with key providers for their trucking
companies at the click of a button.

Carriers and industry service providers have just as challenging of a time discovering each other.

Both carrier and industry service provider members can post items and services for sale/rent on our
marketplace. Carriers now have unlimited posting capabilities in a marketplace where they can sell
and rent equipment. We do not facilitate any transactions or charge any additional fees for users to
conduct business in our marketplace.

Run transportation through a single operating layer that aligns procurement decisions, daily
execution, and freight settlement. Financial outcomes, service targets, and carrier accountability
stay coordinated across the shipment lifecycle.

[Drayage icon]

Turn capacity across modes into governed programs tied to your network priorities. Instead of
reacting to coverage gaps with ad-hoc spot moves, your team operates with planned capacity levers
that protect cost and service targets as conditions change.

Uber Freight TMS draws on freight activity across thousands of shipper networks, with decades of
accumulated data informing routing and capacity decisions. Predictive signals keep the network
aligned as conditions change, so teams act earlier rather than waiting for issues to surface in the
P&L or at the customer level.

## Tap into one of North America’s largest managed transportation and multimodal capacity networks

We translate network‑level patterns into market insights shippers can trust to plan budgets,
navigate volatility, and unlock structural savings

## $17B+

Freight under management

## Strategic logistics built for tomorrow’s disruption

Backed by two decades of industry data, leading technology, and hands-on partnership

[Icon of person on black background]

#### Managed services

Run transportation through a single operating layer that aligns procurement decisions, daily
execution, and freight settlement. Financial outcomes, service targets, and carrier accountability
stay coordinated across the shipment lifecycle.

[Drayage icon]

#### Multi-modal solutions

Turn capacity across modes into governed programs tied to your network priorities. Instead of
reacting to coverage gaps with ad-hoc spot moves, your team operates with planned capacity levers
that protect cost and service targets as conditions change.

[Computer icon]

#### TMS and network intelligence

Uber Freight TMS draws on freight activity across thousands of shipper networks, with decades of
accumulated data informing routing and capacity decisions. Predictive signals keep the network
aligned as conditions change, so teams act earlier rather than waiting for issues to surface in the
P&L or at the customer level.

View More

# Warehousing, Road Haulage, Freight Forwarding In Malaysia Since 2008

UnityLink Services & Agency Sdn Bhd (818133-P) is an integrated logistics company provides supply
chain solutions to all major industries in Malaysia. From customs clearance, storage, staffing to
delivery, we are proud to offer flexible logistics solution catered to our customer’s business
needs.

## Warehouse

3
locations

## Truck

179
units

## Forwarding

195
countries

## Comprehensive Logistics and Supply Chain Solutions

With transportation and warehousing resources in Malaysia, UnityLink offers integrated, single
source solutions to meet the needs of every type of customer, regardless of size or location.

### Air and Ocean Freight

Safe and reliable freight forwarding services between Malaysia and any regions.

### Customs Brokerage

Custom clearance, declaration shipments throughout Malaysia.

### Distribution

Cost-effective, custom solutions by consolidating warehousing and delivery services.

### Road Haulage

Offer domestic trucking, cross border services between Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia.

### Secondment Staffing

Providing workers for short-term warehouse projects.

### Warehousing

Security and specialized storage systems, located in Shah Alam, Port Klang and Johor Bharu.

## Industries We Serve

With over 12 years of experience servicing numerous industries, UnityLink has gained valuable
business expertise that can help you overcome your biggest logistical concerns in everything from
warehousing to trucking and transportation.
* Agriculture
* Automotive
* Building and construction
* Chemical
* Fast moving consumer goods (FMCG)
* Food and beverage
* Health and pharmaceuticals
* Industrial
* Information communications and technology
* Manufacturing
* Print media
* Retail

UnityLink helps business solve their storage and transport logistics with flexible service across
Malaysia.

# Warehousing, Road Haulage, Freight Forwarding In Malaysia Since 2008

UnityLink Services & Agency Sdn Bhd (818133-P) is an integrated logistics company provides supply
chain solutions to all major industries in Malaysia. From customs clearance, storage, staffing to
delivery, we are proud to offer flexible logistics solution catered to our customer’s business
needs.

## Warehouse

3
locations

## Truck

179
units

## Forwarding

195
countries

## Comprehensive Logistics and Supply Chain Solutions

With transportation and warehousing resources in Malaysia, UnityLink offers integrated, single
source solutions to meet the needs of every type of customer, regardless of size or location.

### Air and Ocean Freight

Safe and reliable freight forwarding services between Malaysia and any regions.

### Customs Brokerage

Custom clearance, declaration shipments throughout Malaysia.

### Distribution

Cost-effective, custom solutions by consolidating warehousing and delivery services.

### Road Haulage

Offer domestic trucking, cross border services between Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia.

### Secondment Staffing

Providing workers for short-term warehouse projects.

### Warehousing

Security and specialized storage systems, located in Shah Alam, Port Klang and Johor Bharu.

## Industries We Serve

With over 12 years of experience servicing numerous industries, UnityLink has gained valuable
business expertise that can help you overcome your biggest logistical concerns in everything from
warehousing to trucking and transportation.
* Agriculture
* Automotive
* Building and construction
* Chemical
* Fast moving consumer goods (FMCG)
* Food and beverage
* Health and pharmaceuticals
* Industrial
* Information communications and technology
* Manufacturing
* Print media
* Retail

UnityLink helps business solve their storage and transport logistics with flexible service across
Malaysia.

## Wayne Transports Terminals

Wayne Transports operates through a network of 14 strategically positioned logistics hubs spanning
the nation. Our extensive reach encompasses shipping and freight terminals situated across seven
states: **[Iowa][86]**, **[Illinois][87]**, [**Indiana**][88], **[Minnesota][89]**,

execution, we deliver efficient and dependable freight services to carriers and shippers alike. Our
seamless logistics infrastructure guarantees comprehensive coverage throughout the Lower 48 States,
Alaska, and Canada, ensuring the smooth flow of goods and materials.

and we use state of the art technology to monitor your freight every step of the way.
